name: Grid Scroll Circle Morph
description: Scattered image grid where each photo shrinks into a circle as it scrolls up, behind a fixed centered title, ending on a full-screen text footer panel.
contents: Sparse grid of square images placed on explicit rows and columns
Fixed centered cover title with superscript mark and subtitle
Full-screen footer panel with a paragraph
behavior: Each image scales down and rounds into a circle, scrubbed by scroll
Transform origin sits below each image so it swings as it shrinks
Cover title stays fixed over the grid while scrolling

props.name: items
props.default: 48 sample images placed on the grid

props.name: coverSubtitle
props.default: 並外れたファッション

props.name: footerBody
props.default: From the dawn of civilisation onwards crowds have always undergone the influence of illusions. It is to the creators of illusions that they have raised more temples, statues, and altars than to any other class of men.

editableByProps: Images, alt text and their row and column positions, column count
Cover title, mark, subtitle, footer text and title size
Background, text and footer colors, image contrast
Scroll morph end scale, radius, origin, easing and scroll start and end
Smooth scroll on or off and its lerp

needsCodeEdit.change: Change the cover title position or make it scroll with the page
needsCodeEdit.where: The fixed top-0 left-0 div containing the h2 and h3

needsCodeEdit.change: Animate other properties such as rotation or opacity
needsCodeEdit.where: The .to(image, ...) call in the gridItems forEach

fixed: Takes over page scrolling with Lenis unless smoothScroll is false, so it should be the only smooth scroll on the page
Cover title is position fixed over the viewport for the whole page, so it covers the viewport while the page scrolls
Footer panel is a full-screen block that gives the end of the scroll
